description: This file defines classes for handling 'clearpart' commands in Kickstart scripts, supporting multiple versions and options for partition clearing.

classes.name: FC3_ClearPart
classes.description: Class for handling 'clearpart' command for FC3 version, supporting options for partition removal.

classes.name: F17_ClearPart
classes.description: Subclass extending FC3_ClearPart with support for device list options.

classes.name: F21_ClearPart
classes.description: Subclass extending F17_ClearPart with support for disklabel option.

classes.name: F25_ClearPart
classes.description: Subclass extending F21_ClearPart with support for drives and list options.

classes.name: F28_ClearPart
classes.description: Subclass extending F25_ClearPart with support for cdl option.

classes.name: RHEL7_ClearPart
classes.description: Specific class for RHEL7, inheriting from F28_ClearPart.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the command with optional drives, initAll, type, disklabel, cdl, etc.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns string representation of the command with appropriate options.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns an argument parser for the command options.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command line arguments and sets object attributes accordingly.
